uploadPicker.uploadsContinueWhenThisDialogClosesAfter: Feel free to close this window and keep browsing while your files upload. If you refresh the page, choose the same files or folder to pick up where you left off.
uploadPicker.reselectToResume: Choose the original file to continue from the saved position.
uploadPicker.finishCurrentBatch: Finish or cancel your current uploads before choosing more files, including any paused uploads.
uploadPicker.reselectFailed: Some uploads need their original files again. Use “Choose file to resume” below.

droppedFiles.folderUploadExceedsTheDepthLimit: There are too many nested folders in this upload.
droppedFiles.chooseAtMost10000FilesAtOnce: Choose at most 10,000 files at once.

uploadQueue.chooseAtMost10000FilesAtOnce: Choose at most 10,000 files at once.
uploadQueue.folderUploadExceedsTheDepthLimit: There are too many nested folders in this upload.
uploadQueue.thisServerUploadWasCancelledStartANewUpl: Choose the file again to restart this cancelled upload.
uploadQueue.chooseOriginalFile: Choose the original “{{name}}” file with the same size and modification date.
uploadQueue.unfinishedUpload: There’s an unfinished upload for “{{name}}”. Resume it with the original file, or cancel it before uploading a different version.
uploadQueue.reconnecting: Connection interrupted. We’ll retry when Luma is open and connected.
